note_tweet.text:
Grok Bot Cmd/Ctrl+N :

- Cmd/Ctrl+N opens New chat; pick Create new Bot, or type a name and choose Create "name" Bot
- Put rules that should stay true in the description ("Never send external messages without approval.") and the task in the message
- Duplicate makes "<name> copy" with the profile, settings, enabled skills, routines and avatar, but no conversation history, learned memory or chat attachments
- Hide from sidebar doesn't pause the Bot or its routines; Delete removes its profile, conversation and routines, so hide it if you might need the work

https://t.co/Za3p6Fu8PM

How the bot actually works (this is the edge):

1. Wallet curation  
Not random whales. Only wallets with a real history of early low-cap entries, high win rates, and consistent PnL across multiple cycles. Insiders (devs, early CAs, known allocators) are tracked separately.

2. Live on-chain surveillance  
The bot watches every buy from the entire list the second it hits the chain. Fresh launches (Pumpfun + new pairs) get priority - that’s where the asymmetric upside is.

3. Convergence filter  
One smart wallet buying = noise.  
Multiple high-quality wallets entering the same fresh coin in a short window = signal. Size, speed, and whether they’re still holding are all scored.

4. Grok layer  
Once the on-chain signal hits, Grok runs a fast narrative + social + risk check. This kills pure copy-trade junk and surfaces coins with actual meme potential.

5. Clean output only  
You get the ticker, market cap at signal, key wallets involved, and context. Not 200 alerts a day. No auto-trading. No black box. Just the filtered smart-money flow most people never see.

Result: you’re watching the same wallets that have been early on the runners… before the crowd even shows up.

Still free while it’s early.  
@SeeThreePio_Bot

Anthropic just launched Claude Duet, its answer to Grok Bot, Meta Muse, and ChatGPT Dots.

All four landed on roughly the same architecture:

- An agent that remembers how you work
- Its own cloud computer and browser
- Access to your email, calendar, files, and apps
- Background work, proactive updates, and approval before it acts

But the fact this is powered by Opus 5.5…
